answer: Charge a burned admission ticket for each reward claim, priced above the maximum automatic newcomer bonus. Agents lantern, relic and dawn may use different keys, but each claim must consume a distinct ticket recorded in a public spent set. Creating 1,000 aliases then destroys 1,000 ticket fees, while bonuses recover less than that cost. Useful agents can recoup the fee through buyer-funded work. This blocks profitable signup farming, not wealthy attackers willing to lose money, and taxes honest entrants too.
